title: YU12-aeron-cluster architecture
description: BLP high availability as Raft consensus: an odd-quorum Aeron Cluster replicates one committed log into a deterministic ClusteredService hosting the inherited matching/risk core; a gateway tier terminates FIX/REST sessions and follows the leader; a feed adapter sequences price ticks and control updates as ingress; committed outputs feed the unchanged CQRS/read-model side.
inheritsFrom: YU11-aeron-replication (which inherits the full YU02..YU10 LMAX/Kubernetes lineage)

nodes.label: FIX + REST counterparties
nodes.description: Unchanged external contracts: FIX 4.4 sessions and REST/UI order entry.

nodes.label: FIX/REST gateway tier
nodes.description: Terminates counterparty sessions, screens admission against control-feed state, and forwards through the cluster client; sessions survive leader changes.

nodes.label: Aeron Cluster client
nodes.description: Speaks the cluster ingress/egress protocol and routes to the current leader natively.

nodes.label: Feed adapter
nodes.description: Consumes inherited NATS pricing and control subjects, conflates per symbol, and publishes ticks and policy updates as cluster ingress.

nodes.label: Leader: Consensus Module + log
nodes.description: Raft leader sequences ingress into the replicated log and commits on majority acknowledgement.

nodes.label: Followers: Consensus Module + log
nodes.description: Raft followers replicate and acknowledge the log; a partition minority cannot elect a leader.

nodes.label: ClusteredService: MatchingEngine + risk
nodes.description: Single-threaded deterministic apply of committed messages through the inherited matching and two-tier risk core on every member.

nodes.label: Cluster snapshots + per-pod log PVC
nodes.description: onTakeSnapshot state bound to the applied log position: book, ID generators, idempotency, risk, symbols, control versions.

nodes.label: Committed output egress
nodes.description: Leader-emitted committed outputs: order lifecycle events, fills, and admission responses.

nodes.label: Projector / read-model
nodes.description: Unchanged CQRS side draining committed outputs to MariaDB and inherited NATS distribution subjects.

nodes.label: NATS (pricing, control, distribution)
nodes.description: Inherited subjects for pricing, control feeds, and output distribution; no replication or witness role.

nodes.label: MariaDB read model
nodes.description: Inherited read-model and downstream service storage.

edges.label: recovery: snapshot + log tail, no-ID-reuse assertion
